verdict.rationale: Jan's GitHub and docs say it downloads and runs open LLMs from Hugging Face or local GGUF files, and its built-in API server runs entirely on your computer, powered by llama.cpp. They also describe it as 'Privacy First: Everything runs locally when you want it to', with zero data collection until you opt in; cloud providers are an optional add-on. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that prompts and data never leave the device during local inference.
